author: blu
body: This is a pure function of state and event, in the tcp-step style: step : State, Event -> (State, List Action). It performs no I/O, sets no timers itself, and sends nothing. It decides, and the binding layer (D3) does. That is what makes a datagram protocol -- whose whole difficulty is loss, reordering and duplication -- testable as an ordinary battery sample: a scripted event sequence in, an action trace out, no network and no peer.

author: blu
body: The server's flight 4 landed. Keys are deliverable now, and the client sends its own flight 5 and waits to be acknowledged.
